sources.source_name: 2024 Annual Report of the Maternal and Child Health Death Review Commission (Delaware's Maternal and Child Death Review Commission)

codebook_artifacts.title: 2024 Annual Report of the Maternal and Child Death Review Commission
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Judicial Branch, Maternal and Child Death Review Commission
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Deaths reviewed by the Commission during calendar year 2024, including CDR/SDY, FIMR and MMR case-review streams
codebook_artifacts.notes: Appendix B documents case assignment and selection; Appendix D is a published glossary of population, death and mortality-rate terms. The report explicitly warns that review year is not necessarily death year.

codebook_artifacts.title: 2024 MCDRC Data Addendum
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Judicial Branch, Maternal and Child Death Review Commission
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Detailed tabulations supporting the 2024 annual report
codebook_artifacts.notes: Provides table definitions, denominators, factor flags and disclosure/missingness notes, including the rule that an asterisk replaces results when more than 50 percent of the information is unknown in specified tables.

codebook_artifacts.title: MCDRC Annual Reports index
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Judicial Branch
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Current and historical Commission annual reports and addenda
codebook_artifacts.notes: Authoritative publication index; use it to select the report vintage before comparing years.

variables.label: Number of deaths reviewed by review stream
variables.definition: Count of case reviews completed in 2024: Child Death Review/Sudden Death in the Young, Fetal and Infant Mortality Review, or Maternal Mortality Review. The 103 total comprises 46 CDR/SDY, 48 FIMR and 9 MMR reviews.
variables.universe: Cases assigned to and reviewed by the Commission teams under Appendix B selection rules
variables.time_granularity: annual review year; underlying death years vary
variables.suppression_rules: Aggregate totals are published; small detailed cells may be omitted or combined in tables.
variables.comparability_notes: Do not treat review-year counts as vital-statistics deaths occurring in 2024. MMR cases reviewed in 2024 arose in 2021-2023, and FIMR uses a selected/sample case-review process.

variables.label: Manner of child death
variables.definition: Classification used in the CDR/SDY tables for the circumstances of death.
variables.universe: CDR/SDY cases reviewed in 2024
variables.suppression_rules: Small or non-reportable cells may not be shown.
variables.comparability_notes: Manner is not the same as mechanism/cause. Compare to Crime in Delaware homicide only after matching case jurisdiction and death-year basis; criminal homicide counts and death-review classifications are not interchangeable.

variables.label: Late or absent prenatal care
variables.definition: Prenatal care that began more than six months into pregnancy, or no prenatal care.
variables.universe: Applicable FIMR/MMR case reviews with known prenatal-care information
variables.suppression_rules: The addendum identifies tables where an asterisk is used when more than 50 percent of information is unknown.
variables.comparability_notes: This case-review threshold is not automatically equivalent to PRAMS timing-of-prenatal-care variables or a Kotelchuck adequacy index.

variables.label: Low birthweight
variables.definition: Birthweight under 2,500 grams.
variables.universe: Applicable FIMR cases with known birthweight
variables.suppression_rules: Unknown-heavy tables can be replaced by an asterisk as described in the addendum.
variables.comparability_notes: Definition aligns with the conventional vital-statistics threshold, but the denominator here is selected reviewed cases rather than all live births.

variables.label: Preterm/premature birth
variables.definition: Birth before 37 completed weeks of gestation.
variables.universe: Applicable FIMR cases with known gestational age
variables.suppression_rules: Unknown-heavy tables can be replaced by an asterisk as described in the addendum.
variables.comparability_notes: Comparable in threshold to common birth-record indicators, but not in denominator: FIMR is a reviewed-case stream rather than all births.

variables.label: Maternal-death relationship to pregnancy
variables.definition: Pregnancy-associated death is a death during pregnancy or within one year after pregnancy from any cause. Pregnancy-related death is caused by a pregnancy complication, a chain of events initiated by pregnancy, or aggravation of an unrelated condition by pregnancy physiology.
variables.universe: MMR cases during pregnancy or within one year after pregnancy
variables.time_granularity: underlying death year and review year
variables.suppression_rules: Small numbers are generally presented as case counts or combined periods rather than stable annual rates.
variables.comparability_notes: Do not compare an all-cause pregnancy-associated count directly with a pregnancy-related mortality ratio. The latter uses pregnancy-related deaths per 100,000 live births.

source_variable_names: PRAMS: prenatal-care and pregnancy morbidity items
crosswalk_hints.notes: Potential linkage is conceptual only. MCDRC is a selected case-review universe and PRAMS is a weighted survey of recent live births; require an explicit harmonized threshold and denominator.
Match death year, residency, age and legal classification. Death-review cases and law-enforcement offenses are not the same observational unit.

sources.research_notes: A genuine published glossary and a detailed addendum were found. Definitions are public, but no row-level case dictionary or microdata are public. The report's biggest analytic trap is conflating review year with occurrence year or treating reviewed cases as a population incidence series.

codebook_artifacts.title: Delaware Domestic Violence Coordinating Council FY2025 Annual Report
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Domestic Violence Coordinating Council
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: FY2021-FY2025 domestic-violence incident, court, hotline and service-provider tables
codebook_artifacts.notes: Contains narrative definitions, table labels, denominators and data-source notes, but not a field-level CJIS or service-system data dictionary.

codebook_artifacts.title: Dynamics of Domestic Abuse
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Domestic Violence Coordinating Council
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Council terminology and scope
codebook_artifacts.notes: Public definition and contextual explanation; not a statistical schema.

variables.label: Criminal plus non-criminal domestic violence incidents
variables.definition: Police contacts reported as domestic violence incidents, combining criminal incidents (a crime committed or alleged) and non-criminal incidents (police contact where no crime is alleged, such as a verbal argument without threats).
variables.universe: Domestic violence incidents recorded by Delaware law enforcement in CJIS
variables.suppression_rules: No general suppression rule is stated in the annual report.
variables.comparability_notes: An incident can involve a family member rather than an intimate partner. Do not equate incidents, offenses, victims or people; those are different units.

variables.label: Criminal domestic violence incidents involving injury
variables.definition: Count and percentage of criminal domestic violence incidents in which injury was recorded; the report presents 2,350 and 22 percent for FY2025.
variables.universe: Criminal domestic violence incidents
variables.comparability_notes: This is police-recorded incident injury, not hospitalization, fatal injury, or self-reported victimization; it should not be directly compared with STIPDA assault hospitalization rates.

variables.label: Criminal domestic violence incidents involving intimate partners
variables.definition: Criminal DV incidents involving current or former spouses, current or former dating couples with or without a child in common, or adolescent dating couples, regardless of gender.
variables.universe: Criminal DV incidents classified as involving intimate partners
variables.comparability_notes: Narrower than all domestic violence incidents. Preserve the relationship definition when comparing years or sources.

variables.label: Criminal DV incidents with children present
variables.definition: Count and percentage of criminal domestic violence incidents for which children were recorded as present.
variables.universe: Criminal domestic violence incidents
variables.comparability_notes: This is an incident flag and does not count exposed children. It is not equivalent to DSS self-reported witnessing of adults at home hurting one another.

variables.label: Calls to domestic violence hotlines
variables.definition: Calls received by the domestic violence hotline programs tabulated statewide and by county/language in the annual report.
variables.universe: Calls recorded by participating domestic violence hotline programs
variables.comparability_notes: Calls are service contacts, not unique callers, victims or incidents; one person may generate multiple calls.

variables.label: Protection From Abuse petition activity
variables.definition: Family Court civil-order activity for protection from a family or household member, with report tables for filings and disposition/outcome categories.
variables.universe: PFA matters recorded by Delaware Family Court
variables.comparability_notes: A filing is not an incident, victim, or granted order. Compare outcomes only after aligning court disposition categories.

source_variable_names: Delaware Women Status Report: domestic violence incidents
crosswalk_hints.notes: The Women Status Report reuses DVCC-derived statistics in some figures. Deduplicate by source year and retain the all-DV versus intimate-partner distinction.

source_variable_names: DSS Q38 witnessed adults at home hurting one another
crosswalk_hints.notes: Related but not equivalent: administrative incident flag versus child self-report, different reference periods and units.

sources.research_notes: The annual report is a strong published table-definition source but no public CJIS field layout, Domestic Violence Incident Report codebook, hotline client-level dictionary or service-program extract schema was located. This is therefore partial_published rather than a complete data dictionary.

sources.source_name: Crime in Delaware (Statistical Analysis Center, Delaware Criminal Justice Council)

codebook_artifacts.title: Crime in Delaware 2020-2024
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Criminal Justice Council, Statistical Analysis Center
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Delaware NIBRS-derived reported offenses, clearances and arrests for 2020-2024
codebook_artifacts.notes: Includes methodology, a glossary, offense definitions derived from FBI NIBRS, arrest/offense table definitions and important reporting caveats.

codebook_artifacts.title: Crime in Delaware publications
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Criminal Justice Council, Statistical Analysis Center
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Current and historical Crime in Delaware reports and supplements
codebook_artifacts.notes: Use this index to identify revised/newer series; do not silently mix vintages.

variables.label: Reported/known offenses received by law enforcement
variables.definition: Crimes reported to or otherwise known by law enforcement; each charge within an incident is counted as an offense received.
variables.universe: NIBRS-reportable offenses known to participating Delaware law-enforcement agencies
variables.geography: Delaware; county, agency and municipality where tabulated
categories: Group B arrest-only offense where applicable
missing_codes: Incomplete agency submissions can produce undercounts
variables.suppression_rules: No general cell-suppression rule is stated; small counts are published in many tables.
variables.comparability_notes: This is not a unique-incident or unique-victim count. Multiple charges in one incident are counted separately, and only crime known to police is included.

variables.label: NIBRS crime incident
variables.definition: One or more offenses committed by the same offender or group of offenders acting together at the same time and place.
variables.universe: Reported NIBRS incidents
categories: May contain one or multiple offenses
variables.comparability_notes: Do not substitute offense counts for incident counts. This distinction is also crucial when comparing to DVCC, whose table unit is a domestic-violence incident.

variables.label: Reported offense rate
variables.definition: Number of offenses divided by the relevant population and multiplied by 1,000.
variables.universe: Reported offenses and resident population for the stated geography/year
variables.comparability_notes: Population estimates can revise; preserve the denominator vintage. Not directly comparable to STIPDA rates, which are typically injuries/deaths per 100,000 residents.

variables.label: Offenses cleared
variables.definition: An offense is cleared when a suspect is arrested and referred for prosecution, or exceptionally cleared when the offender is clearly identifiable but cannot be arrested under qualifying circumstances; percent cleared is the cleared share reported for an offense grouping.
variables.universe: Reported offenses eligible for the report's clearance calculation
variables.comparability_notes: A clearance is not a conviction. Timing can cross calendar years, so a simple same-year cleared-count/offense-count interpretation may be misleading without the report methodology.

variables.label: Arrests and arrests per population
variables.definition: Arrest count by offense and demographic category; arrest rate is arrests divided by population and multiplied by 1,000.
variables.universe: Persons arrested and recorded in Delaware NIBRS data
missing_codes: Unknown/not reported demographic categories where shown
variables.comparability_notes: An arrest is not a unique person over the year; a person may be arrested multiple times. Juvenile is defined as under age 18.

variables.label: Violent offense grouping
variables.definition: Offenses involving force or threat of force, including murder/non-negligent manslaughter, human trafficking, kidnapping/abduction, forcible sex offenses, robbery and assault offenses under the report grouping.
variables.universe: Reported Group A offenses in included violent categories
variables.comparability_notes: The grouping is broader than FBI Crime Index violent crime in some contexts. The report notes a classification change for vehicular homicide and three 2024 homicides missing because submissions were unfinished; preserve edition-specific caveats.

crosswalk_hints.notes: Crime data count police-known offenses/charges; MCDRC counts reviewed deaths; STIPDA counts resident deaths or hospital discharges. Harmonize intent, fatality status, age, residency and year before comparison.
DVCC incidents are flagged by relationship/context and may be criminal or non-criminal; Crime in Delaware is offense-centered NIBRS reporting. Never assume one DV incident equals one offense.

sources.research_notes: The report itself supplies a substantial public glossary and FBI-derived offense definitions. Known limitations include crime not reported to police, the 2020-2021 pandemic disruption, changes in classification practices, and incomplete 2024 homicide submissions described in the edition.

sources.source_name: Education Data Reports (39) (Delaware Department of Education)

codebook_artifacts.title: Delaware Department of Education Data Reports index
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Department of Education
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: The cataloged umbrella of education reports, downloads and report-specific documentation
codebook_artifacts.notes: Each report has its own grain and definitions; there is no single dictionary covering all 39 report families.

codebook_artifacts.title: Delaware Report Card Data Dictionary
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Department of Education
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Delaware Report Card measures, including enrollment, student groups, proficiency and graduation
codebook_artifacts.notes: Published measure definitions, subgroup terminology and selected display/suppression information. Applies to the Report Card, not automatically to every downloadable report.

codebook_artifacts.title: Annual Enrollment/Unit Count
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Department of Education
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Annual public-school enrollment/unit-count reporting
codebook_artifacts.notes: Defines the attendance window and notes the FY2021 count-date change from September 30 to November 13.

codebook_artifacts.title: Class Size reports
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Department of Education
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: K-3 class-size reporting and waiver context
codebook_artifacts.notes: Documents classroom assignment and the statutory average-class-size threshold context.

codebook_artifacts.title: K-3 Universal Screening and Interventions
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Department of Education
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: K-3 reading-screening and intervention reports
codebook_artifacts.notes: Report-specific measure descriptions; not a longitudinal student record layout.

codebook_artifacts.title: Data Privacy and Suppression
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Department of Education
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Public DDOE reports and dashboards
codebook_artifacts.notes: Current general privacy rules describe redaction for populations under 15, small corresponding counts and complementary suppression.

variables.label: Students enrolled and in attendance during the unit-count window
variables.definition: Annual count of students enrolled and in attendance during the last 10 school days of the September unit-count period; the count is a principal basis for education funding. For FY2021, the official count date moved from September 30 to November 13.
variables.unit: student enrollment record counted once in the report snapshot
variables.universe: Students enrolled in Delaware public district and charter schools under unit-count rules
variables.geography: State, district/charter and school where available
missing_codes: Redacted display values may appear as dash, blank, asterisk, Protected, less-than-X or greater-than-X variants
variables.suppression_rules: DDOE states that a student or teacher population under 15 is redacted; a corresponding count under 5 or within 5 of the population is redacted, with complementary suppression as needed.
variables.comparability_notes: Not an average daily membership or Census/ACS resident child-population estimate. Account for the FY2021 timing change.

variables.label: On-time regular-diploma graduation rate
variables.definition: Percentage of a first-time ninth-grade cohort earning a regular high-school diploma within four years. The cohort adds transfers in and subtracts documented transfers out, emigrants and deaths.
variables.universe: Delaware public-school first-time grade-9 cohort; private, parochial and homeschool students are excluded
variables.geography: State, district/charter and school; demographic groups where published
categories: Low income and other published groups
variables.suppression_rules: Subject to DDOE public-report privacy and complementary-suppression rules.
variables.comparability_notes: Use the NCES adjusted-cohort method and cohort graduation year. KIDS COUNT reproductions may lag or relabel years; do not compare with educational-attainment percentages among adult residents.

variables.label: Student learning English
variables.definition: Student identified as learning English under the Department's published student-group definition.
variables.universe: Enrolled Delaware public-school students
variables.comparability_notes: Not equivalent to speaking a language other than English at home or limited-English ability in ACS; program-identification rules and exit status matter.

variables.label: Direct-certification low-income student group
variables.definition: From 2013-14 forward, the published low-income measure is based on direct certification through programs such as TANF and SNAP rather than free/reduced-price lunch eligibility.
variables.universe: Enrolled Delaware public-school students
variables.comparability_notes: Do not equate this administrative direct-certification flag with ACS household poverty or legacy free/reduced-price lunch measures.

variables.label: Students meeting or exceeding grade-level standards
variables.definition: Percentage meeting or exceeding the grade-level standard on the applicable state assessment; the dictionary identifies Smarter assessment results for grades 3-8 and SAT-based grade 11 results for ELA and mathematics.
variables.universe: Students with valid applicable assessment results
variables.geography: State through school and subgroup where reportable
variables.suppression_rules: Subject to DDOE privacy and complementary suppression; denominator and participation rules must be retained.
variables.comparability_notes: Assessment, cut-score and participation changes can break trends. Do not compare the percentage with adult educational attainment in the Women Status Report.

variables.label: Students identified through universal screening as potentially reading deficient
variables.definition: Count or percentage of K-3 students identified by the state's universal-screening reporting as having a potential reading deficiency, with intervention approaches reported separately.
variables.universe: K-3 public-school students included in the universal-screening report
variables.geography: State and local education agency/report level
variables.comparability_notes: A screening flag is not a diagnosed disability and is not interchangeable with proficiency on the statewide ELA assessment.

crosswalk_hints.notes: Enrollment is an administrative school snapshot; KIDS COUNT uses ACS/Census resident-population estimates; DPC is a July 1 projection. These are useful denominators only after matching age, residence, institution and date.

source_variable_names: KIDS COUNT graduation from high school
crosswalk_hints.notes: KIDS COUNT identifies DDOE as its provider for this indicator. Compare only identical cohort year, subgroup and revision; avoid double-counting the same underlying statistic.

source_variable_names: Women Status Report women/girls in poverty
crosswalk_hints.notes: Direct certification and Census poverty are different constructs and denominators; label them separately even when used as socioeconomic indicators.

sources.research_notes: The source is an umbrella across 39 report families. Public definitions exist for important measures and some individual downloads, but there is no one schema valid across the whole umbrella. The DDOE Report Card dictionary must not be over-applied to unrelated reports.

sources.source_name: Delaware Women Status Report (The Office of Women’s Advancement and Advocacy)

codebook_artifacts.title: 2024 Delaware Women Status Report
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Department of Human Resources, Office of Women's Advancement and Advocacy
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: The report's compiled demographic, economic, health, safety and representation indicators
codebook_artifacts.notes: Figures and endnotes identify source agencies, surveys, tables and time periods. It is a secondary compilation, not a record-level dataset dictionary.

codebook_artifacts.title: Office of Women's Advancement and Advocacy reports index
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Department of Human Resources
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Current and historical Delaware women reports
codebook_artifacts.notes: Use to identify report edition and avoid mixing indicator vintages.

variables.label: Uninsured women
variables.definition: Percentage of women reported without health insurance using the cited American Community Survey multiyear estimate.
variables.unit: percent of women in the cited ACS universe
variables.universe: Women in the ACS health-insurance universe specified by the cited table/vintage
variables.time_granularity: 2018-2022 five-year ACS estimate in the 2024 report
variables.suppression_rules: Underlying ACS reliability/annotation rules apply; none added by the report is stated.
variables.comparability_notes: Match age universe and ACS vintage before comparing with KIDS COUNT's children/adults without insurance indicator; KIDS COUNT publishes age-specific groups.

variables.source_variable_name: No personal doctor or health care provider
variables.label: Women without a personal provider
variables.definition: Percentage of adult women reporting no personal doctor or health care provider, displayed by race/ethnicity from the cited BRFSS/KFF source.
variables.universe: Adult women in the cited BRFSS estimate
variables.comparability_notes: Access-to-provider is distinct from insurance coverage and from inability to see a doctor because of cost.

variables.source_variable_name: Could not see doctor because of cost
variables.label: Cost-related unmet medical care in past 12 months
variables.definition: Percentage of adult women reporting that in the past 12 months they needed to see a doctor but could not because of cost, displayed by race/ethnicity.
variables.universe: Adult women in the cited BRFSS estimate
variables.time_granularity: past 12 months within cited survey period
variables.comparability_notes: This is self-reported unmet need, not the uninsured rate or absence of a usual provider.

variables.label: Female population below the poverty level
variables.definition: Number and percentage of girls/women whose income is below the official poverty threshold, based on the cited ACS table B17001 and report categories.
variables.unit: person; percent of female population for whom poverty status is determined
variables.universe: Civilian noninstitutionalized/ACS poverty-status universe as defined by the cited ACS table
variables.comparability_notes: Comparable to KIDS COUNT poverty only when the same ACS table, age group and vintage are used. Do not equate with DDOE direct-certified low income.

variables.label: Women in the labor force
variables.definition: Percentage of women in the relevant working-age/civilian population who are employed or unemployed and actively seeking work, using the cited ACS S2301 source; the report also shows women with children.
variables.unit: percent of women in relevant labor-force universe
variables.universe: Women in the age/family-status universe specified by ACS S2301 and the report figure
variables.comparability_notes: Labor-force participation is not the employment-population ratio or unemployment rate; preserve age and parental-status universes.

variables.label: Women's earnings in cents per White man's dollar
variables.definition: Ratio of the cited women's earnings measure to White non-Hispanic men's earnings, expressed as cents per dollar; the report shows, for example, separate ratios for White, Black and Hispanic women.
variables.unit: cents per one dollar of White non-Hispanic men's earnings
variables.universe: Workers in the earnings universe cited by the report's underlying source
variables.comparability_notes: Not the same as an unadjusted all-women/all-men wage gap, equal pay for equal work, hourly-wage ratio, or model-adjusted pay gap. Preserve the White male reference group and earnings universe.

source_variable_names: KIDS COUNT children and adults in poverty
crosswalk_hints.notes: The first two can align through ACS poverty definitions if age/vintage match; DDOE direct certification is an administrative proxy, not the federal poverty-status measure.

source_variable_names: KIDS COUNT children and adults without health insurance
crosswalk_hints.notes: Both use ACS concepts but differ in age/sex universe and possibly table/vintage; compare only after reconstructing the denominator.
The status report cites administrative sources including DVCC. Treat it as secondary presentation and use DVCC as the primary source when definitions and years coincide.

sources.research_notes: This is a curated indicator report drawing from ACS, BRFSS/KFF, DDOE, PRAMS, DVCC and other publishers. It supplies labels, chart universes and citations, but no unified raw schema. For reproducibility, follow each figure's endnote to the primary source rather than assuming one common denominator.

sources.source_name: Delaware Open Data Portal (State of Delaware)

codebook_artifacts.title: Delaware Open Data catalog browser
codebook_artifacts.authority: State of Delaware
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Discovery of independently published Delaware open-data assets
codebook_artifacts.notes: The portal is an umbrella, not a single dataset. Every asset has its own grain, owner, refresh cycle and schema.

codebook_artifacts.title: Delaware Open Data Portal Published Assets
codebook_artifacts.format: Socrata dataset page plus downloadable data dictionary
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Government Information Center / State of Delaware
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: One row per published portal asset in the catalog inventory
codebook_artifacts.notes: The page exposes column labels, API field names and types and links a PDF data dictionary. Dataset identifier is q2kk-gcju.

codebook_artifacts.title: Socrata metadata API for Published Assets
codebook_artifacts.authority: State of Delaware open-data platform
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Machine-readable schema, columns, types and dataset metadata for q2kk-gcju
codebook_artifacts.notes: Use the API field names from this endpoint, not display labels, when generating queries.

codebook_artifacts.title: Student Enrollment
codebook_artifacts.format: Socrata dataset page plus attached PDF dictionary
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Department of Education / State of Delaware
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Annual public-school student-enrollment open-data asset
codebook_artifacts.notes: Representative example showing that subject datasets publish their own schema and attachments; do not infer its fields from the portal inventory.

codebook_artifacts.title: Educator Characteristics
codebook_artifacts.format: Socrata dataset page plus attached dictionary
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Department of Education / State of Delaware
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Educator-characteristics asset
codebook_artifacts.notes: Separate dataset identifier and schema.

variables.label: ID
variables.definition: Unique identifier for a published asset row in the portal's Published Assets inventory.
variables.universe: Assets represented in dataset q2kk-gcju
variables.comparability_notes: This is an asset identifier, not a record identifier inside the linked dataset. Socrata's four-by-four dataset ID in the URL is also distinct.

variables.label: Name
variables.definition: Published title/name of the portal asset.
variables.universe: Assets represented in q2kk-gcju
variables.comparability_notes: Names are labels and may change; use stable identifiers/URLs for joins.

variables.label: Type
variables.definition: Portal asset type, distinguishing datasets and other published asset forms such as stories or visualizations as represented in the inventory.
variables.universe: Assets represented in q2kk-gcju
categories: Story/visualization and other platform asset types as published
variables.comparability_notes: Asset type is catalog metadata and says nothing about the statistical unit inside a dataset.

variables.label: Category
variables.definition: Portal topical category assigned to the published asset.
variables.universe: Assets represented in q2kk-gcju
variables.comparability_notes: Portal category is a browsing taxonomy, not the same as subject variables within an asset.

variables.label: URL
variables.definition: Web address of the published portal asset.
variables.universe: Assets represented in q2kk-gcju
variables.comparability_notes: Prefer the stable dataset identifier embedded in the URL when a title changes.

variables.label: Publication Stage
variables.definition: Lifecycle/publication-stage metadata recorded for a portal asset.
variables.universe: Assets represented in q2kk-gcju
categories: Values published in the portal inventory
variables.comparability_notes: Do not interpret publication stage as data quality, completeness or timeliness without the publisher's workflow documentation.

variables.label: Asset creation and last-data-update timestamps
variables.definition: Floating-timestamp metadata for creation of the asset and the most recent update to its data as recorded in the inventory.
variables.universe: Assets represented in q2kk-gcju
missing_codes: Null/blank if no date is recorded
variables.comparability_notes: Last data update is not necessarily the observation period, coverage end date, metadata modification time or publication date of the underlying records.

variables.label: Portal asset usage counts
variables.definition: Platform-recorded numeric counts of visits and downloads for the published asset.
variables.universe: Assets represented in q2kk-gcju
variables.comparability_notes: Usage metrics do not measure unique people or substantive data records and may reflect platform counting changes.

crosswalk_hints.notes: Use the inventory to discover assets, then fetch each asset's `/api/views/{four-by-four-id}` metadata. Compare actual subject variables only after reading that asset-specific schema.
Potentially the same publisher series, but verify year, snapshot rule, dimensions and revisions in the attached Student Enrollment dictionary before merging.

sources.research_notes: The catalog is not one statistical dataset, so a universal codebook would be misleading. Socrata exposes a machine-readable schema for every asset and many Delaware publishers add PDF dictionaries. The listed variables are specifically for the Published Assets inventory q2kk-gcju, not for all portal datasets.

sources.source_name: STIPDA Injury Data (Delaware Health Statistics Center)

codebook_artifacts.title: STIPDA Injury Data index
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Health and Social Services, Division of Public Health, Delaware Health Statistics Center
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Historical injury summary, mortality and hospitalization products listed by five-year period
codebook_artifacts.notes: Authoritative index, but available series have different endpoint years and product-specific universes.

codebook_artifacts.title: Injury in Delaware, 2006-2010 Summary
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Health Statistics Center
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Injury mortality and hospitalization definitions and indicator summaries for 2006-2010
codebook_artifacts.notes: Documents resident and facility coverage, intent/mechanism concepts, rates and limitations.

codebook_artifacts.title: Injury Deaths, 2014-2018
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Health Statistics Center
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Delaware-resident injury mortality tabulations for 2014-2018
codebook_artifacts.notes: Latest mortality workbook linked from the cataloged STIPDA page at research time.

codebook_artifacts.title: Injury Hospitalizations, 2006-2010
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Health Statistics Center
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Delaware-resident inpatient injury discharges at Delaware facilities for 2006-2010
codebook_artifacts.notes: Hospitalization coverage is narrower than all resident hospitalizations because out-of-state care and non-inpatient encounters are not included.

variables.label: Resident injury deaths
variables.definition: Deaths of Delaware residents classified within the STIPDA injury case definition, tabulated by intent/mechanism and demographic group.
variables.universe: Delaware-resident deaths meeting the injury case definition
variables.time_granularity: five-year pooled period and component year where workbook provides it
missing_codes: Unknown/unspecified intent or mechanism where reported
variables.suppression_rules: Workbook-specific small-number/reliability conventions must be read from the relevant sheet; no unified public field dictionary was located.
variables.comparability_notes: Death-certificate injury mortality is not police offense data or hospital discharge data. Restrict comparisons to the same resident universe and ICD/case-definition era.

variables.label: Crude or age-adjusted injury death rate
variables.definition: Injury deaths divided by population and expressed per 100,000; age-adjusted rates standardize the age distribution as documented in the product.
variables.universe: Delaware-resident injury deaths and corresponding population denominator
variables.suppression_rules: Follow workbook footnotes for small/unstable rates.
variables.comparability_notes: Crude and age-adjusted rates are not interchangeable. Crime in Delaware uses per-1,000 offense rates, so units and numerators differ.

variables.label: Resident inpatient injury discharges
variables.definition: Hospital discharges for Delaware residents admitted to Delaware inpatient facilities and meeting the injury case definition; out-of-state hospital care, clinic/surgicenter care and emergency-department-only visits are excluded.
variables.universe: Delaware residents discharged from Delaware inpatient facilities with qualifying injury diagnosis
missing_codes: Missing/invalid external-cause coding can exclude mechanism/intent classification
variables.suppression_rules: Follow workbook footnotes for small/unstable cells.
variables.comparability_notes: A discharge is not a unique person; readmissions can be counted. Coverage excludes Delaware residents treated outside the state.

variables.label: Intent classification
variables.definition: Whether the injury was unintentional, self-inflicted, assault/homicide, undetermined, or another intent category used by STIPDA.
variables.universe: Qualifying injury deaths/discharges with usable intent coding
variables.comparability_notes: Fatal and nonfatal labels differ (suicide versus self-harm attempt; homicide versus assault). Do not collapse without retaining outcome type.

variables.label: Mechanism/cause of injury
variables.definition: External mechanism category used to organize injury events, including falls, drowning, fire/burn, firearm, motor-vehicle traffic, poisoning and other mechanisms.
variables.universe: Qualifying injury events with usable mechanism coding
variables.comparability_notes: Mechanism and intent are orthogonal: firearm is a mechanism and may be suicide, homicide, unintentional or undetermined. Preserve both dimensions.

crosswalk_hints.notes: STIPDA uses health outcomes, Crime in Delaware uses offenses/charges, and DVCC uses police incidents. Align fatal/nonfatal status, external cause, relationship, unit and denominator.
STIPDA is vital-statistics population surveillance; MCDRC is case review. MCDRC may add circumstances but review-year totals are not incidence counts.

sources.research_notes: Published methodology and table workbooks exist, but no consolidated row-level dictionary was located. The web index is historical: mortality extends later than hospitalization on the page, so comparisons should not assume common years.

codebook_artifacts.authority: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Standard Phase 8 PRAMS analytic variables, birth-certificate variables, questionnaire variables, weights and operations variables, including participating Delaware records for applicable years
codebook_artifacts.notes: Full published variable names, labels, codes and missing-value conventions. State-added questions require the Delaware questionnaire/supplement for the applicable year.

codebook_artifacts.title: PRAMS Questionnaires
codebook_artifacts.authority: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Question wording and response choices by PRAMS phase
codebook_artifacts.notes: Question wording must be matched to phase; a label alone is insufficient for longitudinal harmonization.

codebook_artifacts.title: PRAMS Methodology
codebook_artifacts.authority: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Sampling, data collection, weighting and representativeness
codebook_artifacts.notes: Use analysis weights and design variables; PRAMS is not a simple random sample.

codebook_artifacts.title: Delaware PRAMS 2020 Analysis Report
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Division of Public Health
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Delaware 2020 weighted indicators and state reporting definitions
codebook_artifacts.notes: State summary product; consult the Phase 8 codebook for field-level codes.

variables.label: Analysis weight
variables.definition: Final record weight used to produce population-representative PRAMS estimates after sampling, nonresponse and noncoverage adjustments under CDC methodology.
variables.unit: weighted live-birth population represented by respondent
variables.universe: Eligible PRAMS respondents in the analytic file
variables.geography: State/site; Delaware when filtered to Delaware records
variables.suppression_rules: Published estimates should follow CDC/state reliability and response-rate guidance; raw weighted estimates are not automatically releasable.
variables.comparability_notes: Required for prevalence estimates. Unweighted respondent percentages are not comparable to Delaware report estimates.

variables.label: Prepregnancy BMI and BMI group from birth certificate
variables.definition: Calculated maternal prepregnancy body mass index and grouped BMI category using birth-certificate height and prepregnancy weight variables.
variables.universe: Recent live births with usable maternal height and prepregnancy weight on the birth certificate
variables.comparability_notes: Birth-certificate-derived BMI can differ from questionnaire-derived self-report. MCDRC BMI factors concern reviewed deaths, not the PRAMS live-birth population.

variables.label: Diabetes before or during pregnancy
variables.definition: Phase 8 analytic indicators distinguish diabetes present before pregnancy from gestational diabetes diagnosed during the index pregnancy.
variables.universe: PRAMS respondents with applicable Phase 8 questionnaire information
missing_codes: .B: blank/don't know as specified in Phase 8 codebook
variables.comparability_notes: Keep preexisting and gestational diabetes separate. MCDRC's gestational-diabetes review factor is a case-review finding and may use medical-record evidence rather than maternal survey response.

variables.label: Hypertension before pregnancy and during pregnancy
variables.definition: Phase 8 analytic indicators distinguish high blood pressure present before pregnancy from high blood pressure during the index pregnancy.
variables.universe: PRAMS respondents with applicable Phase 8 information
variables.comparability_notes: Do not combine chronic hypertension, pregnancy hypertension and preeclampsia without an explicit crosswalk. MCDRC review factors may use clinical records.

variables.label: Depression before pregnancy / depression diagnosis during pregnancy
variables.definition: Phase 8 variables distinguish depression before pregnancy from being diagnosed with depression during the index pregnancy.
variables.universe: PRAMS respondents with applicable Phase 8 information
variables.comparability_notes: A diagnosis item differs from symptom screening or general emotional-health status. Do not equate with DSS youth negative-affect items.

variables.label: Infant breastfed at discharge/birth-certificate indicator
variables.definition: Birth-certificate breastfeeding indicator carried into the PRAMS analytic file.
variables.universe: Live births with birth-certificate breastfeeding information
variables.comparability_notes: This birth-certificate field is not equivalent to questionnaire measures of ever breastfed, current breastfeeding or duration. MCDRC unsafe-sleep review tables use a different reviewed-case universe.

variables.label: Health-care worker asked about emotional or physical abuse
variables.definition: Analytic indicator of whether a health-care worker asked the respondent about someone hurting her emotionally or physically during the relevant maternity-care period specified by the Phase 8 item.
variables.universe: PRAMS respondents receiving applicable care and answering the item
variables.comparability_notes: This measures screening by a provider, not abuse prevalence, DV incident counts or police contact.

crosswalk_hints.notes: PRAMS is weighted recent-live-birth surveillance with questionnaire/birth-certificate variables; MCDRC is selected case review using records. Compare prevalence only within like universes.
Provider screening, insurance, usual provider and cost barriers are distinct access constructs; do not collapse into a single binary variable without retaining the original item.

sources.research_notes: Delaware PRAMS uses CDC's standardized codebooks and phase questionnaires, which are complete public documentation for standard fields. State-added items and report-specific recodes must be matched to the Delaware questionnaire/report year. The sampling universe is women with recent live births, not all pregnant women or fetal deaths.

codebook_artifacts.format: Indicator page with definition/source and download

codebook_artifacts.notes: Secondary dissemination of a DDOE administrative measure.

codebook_artifacts.title: Child population by single age
codebook_artifacts.format: Indicator page with definition/source and download
codebook_artifacts.authority: Annie E. Casey Foundation using U.S. Census Bureau population estimates
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Annual population estimates by single year of age
codebook_artifacts.notes: Vintage-specific estimates may revise earlier years; retain the vintage.

variables.label: Children under age 18
variables.definition: Estimated number of resident children under age 18 from the cited ACS DP05 five-year estimate.
variables.universe: Resident population under age 18
missing_codes: Portal blank/not available; ACS annotations where applicable
variables.suppression_rules: Underlying Census publication and reliability rules apply.
variables.comparability_notes: This is a resident population estimate, not school enrollment, a July 1 projection, or an unduplicated service count.

variables.label: Children as a share of total population
variables.definition: Children under age 18 expressed as a percentage of the total resident population in the same ACS period/geography.
variables.universe: Total resident population
variables.comparability_notes: Do not compare this percent with age-specific distribution percentages whose denominator is children only.

variables.label: Children and adults below poverty by age group
variables.definition: Number and percentage of persons with income below the official poverty level, using ACS S1701 and the indicator's age groups.
variables.unit: persons; percent of age-group poverty universe
variables.universe: Population for whom poverty status is determined
variables.comparability_notes: Use the exact age group and ACS vintage. Administrative low-income flags such as DDOE direct certification are not the same measure.

variables.label: Uninsured children and working-age adults
variables.definition: Number and percentage without health insurance coverage using ACS S2701 for the indicator's age groups.
variables.unit: persons; percent of age-group civilian noninstitutionalized population
variables.universe: Civilian noninstitutionalized population in the listed age group
variables.comparability_notes: Age 18 placement differs among common youth definitions. Match sex/age universe before comparing with Women Status Report uninsured estimates.

variables.label: Public high-school students graduating within four years
variables.definition: Percentage of students in the adjusted high-school cohort graduating within four years, accounting for documented transfers/dropouts under the provider's cohort method.
variables.universe: Delaware public-school adjusted graduation cohort
missing_codes: Portal not available/suppressed; DDOE suppression where applicable
variables.suppression_rules: Underlying DDOE public-report privacy rules apply.
variables.comparability_notes: This is a secondary publication of DDOE data. Use the DDOE cohort definition and edition as primary documentation and avoid counting it as an independent estimate.

variables.source_variable_name: Indicator 100: Child population by single age
variables.label: Estimated resident children by age
variables.definition: Annual population estimate for each single year of age in the indicator's child-age range, using the cited Census population-estimates vintage.
variables.universe: Resident population at each single year of age
variables.comparability_notes: Census population-estimate vintages revise prior years. Do not compare a revised historical estimate with a DPC projection as though both were observed values.

source_variable_names: DPC population projection by single age
crosswalk_hints.notes: KIDS COUNT/ACS is an estimate, DPC is a projection, and DDOE is enrolled students. A comparison function should expose source type, reference date and age/school universe.

source_variable_names: Women Status Report corresponding ACS indicators
crosswalk_hints.notes: These may be harmonizable through identical ACS tables if vintage, sex, age and geography match. Otherwise retain separate measures.

sources.research_notes: KIDS COUNT is an indicator portal, not a homogeneous dataset. Every indicator has a public Definition and Source section and download, but provider, time basis and universe vary. The examples above cover the catalog's central cross-source concepts; automation should retrieve and store indicator ID plus provider metadata.

codebook_artifacts.title: Delaware Population Consortium Projection Data
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Office of State Planning Coordination / Delaware Population Consortium
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Adopted population, household, employment and seasonal-population projection products
codebook_artifacts.notes: The 2025 Consortium adopted the 2024 projection series rather than producing a new 2025 series.

codebook_artifacts.title: Delaware Population Consortium Annual Population Projections, Version 2024.0
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Population Consortium
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Version 2024.0 population, components, households, employment and seasonal projections
codebook_artifacts.notes: Documents cohort-component assumptions, race/ethnicity groups, geographies, dates and footnotes.

codebook_artifacts.title: DPC 2024.0 Annual Report Tables
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Population Consortium
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Annual summary tables underlying the published projection report
codebook_artifacts.notes: Point-in-time population/household tables and five-year component totals must be distinguished using footnotes.

codebook_artifacts.title: DPC 2024.0 Single-Year and Five-Year Age Cohorts
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Population Consortium
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Age-cohort projection tables
codebook_artifacts.notes: Provides annual projections at finer age resolution than the report summary.

codebook_artifacts.title: DPC 2024.0 Single-Year, Single-Age, Race and Sex Projections
codebook_artifacts.authority: Delaware Population Consortium
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Detailed age-by-race/ethnicity-by-sex projection tables
codebook_artifacts.notes: Race groups are mutually exclusive as documented; age runs through 100-plus.

variables.label: Projected resident population as of July 1
variables.definition: Cohort-component projection beginning with the July 1, 2020 population by age, race/ethnicity and sex and applying survival, fertility and migration assumptions.
variables.universe: Resident population in the projection geography
variables.geography: Delaware, counties, Wilmington, Dover and Newark; separate municipal products where published
variables.suppression_rules: No general small-cell suppression stated for public projection tables.
variables.comparability_notes: A projection is not an ACS estimate or actual enrollment count. Retain projection version because assumptions and historical controls can change.

variables.label: Mutually exclusive projection race/ethnicity
variables.definition: Projection classification consisting of White alone non-Hispanic, Black alone non-Hispanic, Hispanic of any race, and Other non-Hispanic; Other includes principally Asian and multiracial populations, and multiple-race records are assigned to Other non-Hispanic.
variables.universe: Projected resident population
variables.comparability_notes: Not directly comparable with ACS tables that publish Asian, AI/AN, NHPI, some-other-race and two-or-more-races separately, nor with school-survey mark-all-that-apply race questions.

variables.label: Five-year population-change components
variables.definition: Projected births and deaths over a five-year interval and net migration defined as in-migrants minus out-migrants; report tables mark five-year totals beginning with the specified year.
variables.universe: Population component events for the projection geography
variables.geography: Delaware and counties/major cities where table provides
variables.comparability_notes: These are interval totals, unlike July 1 population point estimates. Net migration can be negative and is not gross in- or out-migration.

variables.label: Projected occupied households
variables.definition: Projected household count for the stated geography and July 1 year using the DPC household projection method.
variables.universe: Projected households in the geography
variables.comparability_notes: A household is not a housing unit; vacant units are excluded. Household change tables may be interval changes rather than point estimates.

variables.source_variable_name: Jobs by place of work / jobs by residence / net commuting
variables.label: Projected employment and commuting balance
variables.definition: Place-of-work jobs are jobs located in the geography and exclude self-employed, private-household and direct-farm employment under the report definition. Jobs by residence represent employed residents and can reflect multiple jobs; net commuting is inflow minus outflow.
variables.universe: Covered employment and employed residents in projection geographies
variables.comparability_notes: Jobs are not unique workers; a person may hold multiple jobs. Preserve exclusions and the sign convention for net commuting.

variables.label: Estimated peak-season population associated with seasonal housing
variables.definition: Seasonal population estimate for June through August derived from seasonal/vacant housing assumptions, including an 80 percent occupancy assumption and 2.64 persons per occupied seasonal unit in the 2024.0 report; it excludes hotels, motels, campgrounds, recreational vehicles and day visitors.
variables.universe: Persons associated with occupied seasonal housing under DPC assumptions
variables.comparability_notes: Not a year-round resident population and excludes several visitor-accommodation types. Use the PDF's version-specific 2.64-person assumption; do not substitute conflicting summary-page text.

crosswalk_hints.notes: DPC projections may be used for planning scenarios, but published rate series often use Census estimates. A comparison function should never silently replace the publisher's denominator.

source_variable_names: DDOE/KIDS COUNT/PRAMS/YRBS race and ethnicity variables
crosswalk_hints.notes: DPC's four mutually exclusive groups collapse Asian and multiracial into Other non-Hispanic. Harmonization requires an explicit loss-of-detail flag.

sources.research_notes: The PDF and workbooks form a public codebook/methodology package. Table footnotes distinguish July 1 point estimates from five-year totals. Version 2024.0 is the currently adopted series documented at research time, even though the 2025 meeting adopted it without a new projection vintage.

codebook_artifacts.title: Delaware Youth Risk Behavior Survey
codebook_artifacts.format: HTML index with Delaware questionnaires and detailed/demographic/trend tables

codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Delaware middle- and high-school YRBS administrations and published tables
codebook_artifacts.notes: Authoritative Delaware project page; documents representativeness exceptions, including the nonrepresentative 2019 statewide high-school result.

codebook_artifacts.title: YRBS Data and Documentation
codebook_artifacts.format: HTML index with data, documentation and codebooks
codebook_artifacts.authority: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: National, state, territorial, tribal and local YRBS datasets by cycle
codebook_artifacts.notes: Use cycle-specific documentation; site questionnaires can omit or add items.

codebook_artifacts.title: 2023 National YRBS Data User's Guide
codebook_artifacts.authority: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: 2023 national YRBS file structure, variable coding, design and analysis
codebook_artifacts.notes: Documents raw q-number fields, derived qn-number indicators, weights/design variables and minimum denominator guidance. Delaware's site file must be checked against its own questionnaire.

codebook_artifacts.title: 2023 YRBS Standard Analytic Data File Documentation
codebook_artifacts.authority: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Combined standard analytic data file across YRBS sites and years
codebook_artifacts.notes: Defines sitecode, sitetype, year and standardized questionnaire/derived variables for cross-site analyses. Availability varies by site and year.

codebook_artifacts.title: YRBS Questionnaires
codebook_artifacts.authority: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
codebook_artifacts.applies_to: Cycle-specific national and standard question wording and response options
codebook_artifacts.notes: Question number alone is not stable across years; pair it with cycle and wording.

variables.label: YRBS site identifiers and site type
variables.definition: Combined-file identifiers for the survey site and its type; numeric site type distinguishes district, state and national records.
variables.universe: Records in the standard analytic data file
variables.geography: Survey site; Delaware when sitecode selects Delaware
variables.suppression_rules: Public estimates may be withheld when data are not representative or denominator/reliability requirements are not met.
variables.comparability_notes: Filtering to state type is not sufficient; select the Delaware sitecode and survey year. District and state estimates have different target populations.

variables.label: YRBS survey year
variables.definition: Survey cycle/year associated with the respondent record or standardized indicator.
variables.universe: YRBS analytic records
variables.time_granularity: biennial odd-year cycle for standard YRBS
variables.suppression_rules: Not applicable to the year field.
variables.comparability_notes: Question availability and wording change by year. Delaware 2019 statewide high-school data were not representative because of low school participation; only Kent County was representative per the UD page.

variables.label: Raw item responses
variables.definition: Question-numbered fields preserve the selected response category to each cycle's questionnaire item; the 2023 national file contains q1 through q87, but site instruments and other years can differ.
variables.universe: Students asked the applicable question in the sampled grade/site
variables.time_granularity: item-specific reference period within survey cycle
categories: Item-specific response codes defined in the cycle codebook
missing_codes: Missing/not asked/logically skipped codes defined in the cycle codebook
variables.suppression_rules: Estimate-level rules rather than raw field suppression; CDC analyses require adequate denominator and representative weighted data.
variables.comparability_notes: Never crosswalk by q-number alone. Match full wording, reference period, response set, grade universe and cycle.

variables.label: Dichotomized YRBS risk/behavior indicators
variables.definition: Derived item indicators conventionally coded 1 for the response of analytic interest (Yes) and 2 for all other included responses (No), with the exact derivation specified by the cycle codebook.
variables.universe: Respondents with valid answers used in the derived indicator
variables.suppression_rules: CDC guidance does not report estimates with denominator below 30 and applies representativeness/reliability criteria; Delaware tables may add local rules.
variables.comparability_notes: Derived prevalence may combine several raw response categories. Compare only identical derivations, not merely similar labels.

variables.label: Survey weight and complex-design variables
variables.definition: Weight adjusts for sample selection, nonresponse and population distribution; stratum and primary sampling unit variables identify the complex sample design for valid standard errors.
variables.universe: Records in a representative weighted YRBS analytic file
missing_codes: Unweighted/nonrepresentative cycles may lack a valid analysis weight
variables.suppression_rules: Nonrepresentative site-year estimates should not be presented as population estimates.
variables.comparability_notes: Use survey-design procedures. Raw percentages and ordinary standard errors are not equivalent to published weighted estimates.

variables.label: Age, sex, grade, Hispanic ethnicity and race
variables.definition: The opening 2023 national questionnaire items collect age, sex, grade, Hispanic/Latino ethnicity and race; race permits multiple selections and analytic race/ethnicity variables may be derived separately.
variables.universe: Students completing the 2023 national/compatible site instrument
categories: Grades 9-12 and other response where applicable
variables.suppression_rules: Small/unreliable demographic cells may not be reported.
variables.comparability_notes: Derived mutually exclusive race/ethnicity is not the same as raw mark-all race responses and differs from DPC's four-group projection classification.

crosswalk_hints.concept: Youth tobacco, alcohol, cannabis, bullying and mental health
crosswalk_hints.notes: Conceptually similar, but DSS and YRBS differ in grades, cadence, wording, reference periods and response options. Automate comparison only after a human-reviewed item-level mapping that stores instrument year and exact wording.

source_variable_names: YRBS q4-q5/raw and derived race variables
crosswalk_hints.notes: Both school surveys can allow multiple race responses, while DPC uses four mutually exclusive groups. Retain raw selections and derived coding separately.

sources.research_notes: YRBS has full public CDC codebooks and questionnaires plus Delaware-specific UD tables and instruments. Site and year matter: not all standard questions are asked everywhere, and a nonrepresentative site-year cannot be treated as a statewide population estimate.

variables.label: Race or ethnicity, mark all that apply
variables.definition: Student-selected race/ethnicity categories on the 2025 grade-5 instrument, with multiple responses permitted.
variables.universe: 2025 fifth-grade DSS respondents
variables.geography: Delaware public schools; reportable state/local breakouts
categories: Native Hawaiian or other Pacific Islander
variables.suppression_rules: Public table suppression/reliability rules are report-specific; no complete public microdata rulebook was located.
variables.comparability_notes: Not mutually exclusive. Do not directly compare with DPC's mutually exclusive four-group race/ethnicity projection without a documented derivation.

variables.source_variable_name: Q11-Q12 (2025 fifth-grade): breakfast and food insufficiency
variables.label: Breakfast days and past-month hunger due to insufficient food
variables.definition: Q11 asks on how many of the past seven days the student ate breakfast (0-7); Q12 asks whether in the past month the student went hungry because there was not enough food at home.
variables.universe: 2025 fifth-grade DSS respondents
variables.comparability_notes: Breakfast frequency and food insufficiency are distinct constructs. Do not equate Q12 with household income poverty or SNAP participation.

variables.label: Nonschool screen, gaming, physical activity and reading time
variables.definition: Separate items ask usual nonschool online/TV time, video-game time, physically active play/exercise/sports time and reading-for-pleasure time.
variables.universe: 2025 fifth-grade DSS respondents
variables.comparability_notes: Do not sum online/TV and video games without checking overlap. Physical-activity wording and duration differ from YRBS days-with-60-minutes indicators.

variables.label: Feels safe at school and in neighborhood
variables.definition: Separate yes/no self-report items about feeling safe at school and feeling safe in the respondent's neighborhood.
variables.universe: 2025 fifth-grade DSS respondents
variables.comparability_notes: Perceived safety is not an incident count or objective crime rate; school and neighborhood are separate contexts.

variables.label: School bullying, electronic bullying and witnessed violence at home
variables.definition: Q35 asks whether the student was bullied at school in the past 30 days; Q37 asks about electronic bullying in the past 30 days; Q38 asks whether the student has witnessed adults at home hurting one another.
variables.universe: 2025 fifth-grade DSS respondents
variables.time_granularity: past 30 days for bullying; lifetime/unspecified ever wording for witnessed home violence as printed
variables.comparability_notes: Keep school bullying, electronic bullying and home violence separate. Q38 is a student's self-report and is not equivalent to DVCC's police-recorded 'children present' flag.

variables.label: Ever cigarette, vaping, alcohol or marijuana use
variables.definition: Separate lifetime items ask whether the student ever smoked most or all of a cigarette, ever used an electronic vapor product, ever had more than a sip of alcohol, and ever used marijuana.
variables.universe: 2025 fifth-grade DSS respondents
variables.comparability_notes: The behavioral threshold differs by substance: cigarette requires most/all of a cigarette and alcohol requires more than a sip. Match exact wording before comparing with YRBS lifetime indicators.

variables.label: Recency/frequency of eight substance behaviors
variables.definition: Frequency items cover cigarettes, vaping, cigars, chewing tobacco, alcohol, marijuana, dactyls and prescription-drug misuse using a common ordered response set.
variables.universe: 2025 fifth-grade DSS respondents
categories: Used before but not in past year
A few times in past year
variables.comparability_notes: These categories are not equivalent to YRBS past-30-day day counts. Any binary current-use crosswalk is inferred and must state its chosen threshold.

variables.source_variable_name: Q80-Q85 (2025 fifth-grade): emotional health and life evaluation
variables.label: Negative affect, help-seeking, emotional-health rating and Cantril ladder
variables.definition: Items include ever experiencing the specified negative feelings, frequency of getting help, self-rated emotional health from excellent to very bad, and 0-10 ladder ratings for current life and expected life in five years.
variables.universe: 2025 fifth-grade DSS respondents
variables.time_granularity: item-specific; current and expected five-year life evaluation
categories: 0 worst possible life through 10 best possible life
variables.comparability_notes: Self-rated emotional health, negative affect and life satisfaction are distinct. They are not diagnoses and should not be merged with PRAMS depression-diagnosis variables or YRBS sadness/suicidality without exact wording review.

crosswalk_hints.notes: Require exact item wording, substance definition, threshold and reference period. DSS grade-5 categories cannot be assumed equivalent to YRBS past-30-day indicators.
School/electronic bullying, witnessed household violence and police-recorded child presence are related but non-equivalent constructs.

source_variable_names: YRBS sadness, mental-health and suicidality items
crosswalk_hints.notes: Only compare same item wording/reference period. Keep general emotional-health rating, negative affect, help-seeking, life evaluation and suicidality separate.

sources.research_notes: Public questionnaires and domain/trend documents support a partial codebook, but no public record-layout dictionary or downloadable microdata file was located; access is by data request. DSS is annual and principally covers grades 5, 8 and 11, whereas YRBS is biennial and targets different middle/high-school grade universes. COVID-era missing 2020 administration and 2021 mode/participation changes should be flagged in trends.
